objective: Complete priorities 1 through 6 and verify quality against the product's author-facing goals.

requirements.name: Editorial judgment and Writing Voice
requirements.acceptance: Focused, evidence-backed chapter review and revisions improve the author's decisions while preserving established facts, knowledge, voice and deliberate ambiguity. Evaluate omissions, false alarms, inventions and retained/rejected edits on fresh connected prose.
implemented: Focused passage and Plan-chapter critique
Exact quote/offset validation with unsupported findings withheld
Visible uncertainty, strengths, review limits and minimal intervention
Approved Writing Voice guidance included in selection and chapter preparation with stale-context checks
Read-only critique cannot be applied as a prose mutation
Unique exact source quotation can recover inaccurate provider offsets, with disclosed correction and unchanged raw feedback
remaining: Author assessment of connected chapter critique, including omissions, false alarms and kept/rejected edits
Evaluate live approved Writing Voice revisions and refinement across fresh original chapters

requirements.name: Memory accuracy and review workload
requirements.acceptance: Authors can inspect exact evidence, correct person/place classification, triage efficiently, retain unfinished corrections and reject stale decisions. Measure missing and unwanted suggestions on fresh material and observe review burden.
implemented: Grammar-aware suppression of temporal/clausal openers and restrictive modifiers
Correctable entity types retained across rescans
Source-, suggestion- and Storyline-scoped review versions
Main-editor Memory suggestion inbox with exact evidence, retained corrections and explicit refreshed review
Entity-type correction refuses an incompatible existing identity before alias mutation
remaining: Observe author review time, omissions and unwanted suggestions on fresh original prose
Address or explicitly scope uncased-script extraction and ambiguous capitalized entity types

requirements.name: Daily writing and review polish
requirements.acceptance: Saved guidance is compact; unfinished work remains visible/recoverable; revision actions stay reachable on a laptop; keyboard triage and passage comparisons reduce review effort.
implemented: Compact saved Plan brief with recovered/dirty fields expanded
Selection actions outside scrolling context
Arrow/Home/End continuity navigation
Exact-text word comparison with additions/removals
WebKit first-focus caret restored after native focus handling; pointer choice and latest caret preserved
remaining: Physical/native accessibility walkthrough, including VoiceOver and long writing sessions

requirements.name: Actual mobile companion delivery
requirements.acceptance: A published book opens on physical iPhone and Android; scene-aware voice survives interruption/reconnect; encrypted captured ideas return to desktop review. Unfinished capture and reading location survive cold restart without plaintext storage.
implemented: Device-encrypted companion recovery
Cold/offline restart and idempotent capture retry
Cross-window sign-out redaction
Atomic encrypted SQLite snapshot/auth/recovery storage, verified legacy migration
Conditional migration and auth lease fences preserve refreshed data and prevent in-flight SDK refresh from restoring signed-out credentials
remaining: Physical iPhone and Android reading, audio permission/routing, interruption/reconnect and cold restart
Approved deployed connection: authorization, revocation, rotation, deletion and desktop review handoff
Real-device encrypted keys and credential migration acceptance

requirements.name: Packaged-app recovery
requirements.acceptance: Forced termination during saves, multi-scene apply/undo and restores recovers a coherent book. Unknown newer writing is retained and requires explicit reviewed resolution. Native restart and backup restoration preserve exact prose and history.
implemented: Durable write-ahead book transactions
Recovery at the shared lock before cooperating reads
Explicit fingerprint-guarded recovery comparison and resolution
Committed recovery journals cannot be rolled back by resolution choices
Cross-project configuration restores rejected before mutation; selected prose remains separately restorable
remaining: Full signed/clean-machine multi-scene GUI recovery and upgrade acceptance
Physical power-loss and noncooperating-writer limitations remain explicit

requirements.name: Release readiness
requirements.acceptance: Signed/notarized architecture-specific artifacts match reviewed source, install on clean Apple Silicon and Intel machines, support safe recovery/upgrades, and pass accessibility and chosen-deployment security gates.
implemented: Pinned local Python, Codex and Git runtimes prepared
Reviewed core files compared byte-for-byte to the arm64 packaged runtime
Developer ID, hardened runtime, notarization, Gatekeeper and architecture gates wired into release verification
Compatible fast-uri and brace-expansion security patches installed
Committed-source bundle provenance with clean tracked source scope and exact core/binary hashes
remaining: Clean Apple Silicon and Intel installation and upgrades
Resolve or verify mitigation of unpatched node-forge mobile build dependency advisory
Target deployment authorization, revocation, key rotation and deletion drills
